data.exact_reserve_text: The result for the year included net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 9.8m (2021: reserve release of GBP 2.1m) which deteriorated the combined ratio by 5.5% (2021: benefit of 1.5%). This strengthening was driven by reserve increases in relation to the China flood losses in Henan and Typhoon Rai, both on our Treaty Property Reinsurance class of business, partly offset by reserve releases on our professional lines class following favourable loss experience.

data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development triangle, gross prior-year development for years 2020 and earlier produced a net release of approximately GBP 14.2m (c. -3.35% of opening gross claims outstanding). Management, however, describes a net prior-year reserve strengthening of GBP 9.8m after reinsurance, driven by reserve increases for the China Henan floods and Typhoon Rai in the Treaty Property Reinsurance portfolio, partly offset by releases in Professional Lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (claims development table). Management narrative quotes a net prior year strengthening of GBP 9.8m (net of reinsurance) which differs from the gross triangle-derived net release (~GBP 14.2m); no explicit gross GROSS 'movement in prior years' line item was found. A small portfolio transfer is shown in technical notes which may affect comparability. Figures in the triangle and balance sheet are presented in GBP 000; converted to millions in this output.
